staging_note: STAGED DESIGN COPY, not wired. Selys's pool is shipped; chatted_with_selys accrues today. Two stages only — she goes from professional to person, and that is the whole arc v1 needs.

lines: Oh good, a face that doesn't come with a complaint form. You can stand there as long as you like.
Tell Erin her letters are still too long. And that I read all of them. Do not pass on the second part.
Rough week on the board. If you're taking work, take the sane jobs — I flag the sane ones. It's not a service everyone gets.

hub_options.text: Shivertail — any relation to the Guildmistress?

selys_gran.speaker: Selys
selys_gran.text: Grandmother. Yes, THE Tekshia Shivertail. Yes, she still throws a spear better than half the Silver-ranks. No, I will not introduce you when she's in a mood, which is always. I wanted to be her when I was small. Then I noticed the paperwork ran in the family and picked the desk with better hours.

options.text: You wanted to be a hero?

selys_gran_two.speaker: Selys
selys_gran_two.text: Everyone behind this counter did, once. Then you log your first casualty report. The desk keeps more people alive than a sword does — that took me years to believe, so you don't have to believe it today. Now stop making me sincere during business hours.

perk.summary: ⚑ First pick at the board (spec default). The stage-2 pool announces it in fiction ('I flag the sane ones'). Mechanical backing, cleanest v1: ONE stage-gated hub option — 'Anything on the board worth my time?' — pointing at a vetted job with gold on completion (a small authored bounty, hide_when claimed). A REPEATABLE rotating board is new machinery; flagged as out of v1 scope. User picks shape.
